phases.name: Ski Prep
phases.focus: Enhance strength and stability for skiing

non_negotiables: No deep knee flexion under load

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Post-Meniscus Strength & Ski Prep"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Regain strength and stability post-meniscus injury for return to skiing"
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Body":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "Core & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          superman 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
